rounds.literal: Indvodza ibambe inkunzi letfukutsele timphondvo, tinyawo tiyatfutfumela kodvwa ayibaleki.
rounds.story: Bantfu bakusho uma kunenkinga lenkhulu futsi sekudzingeka sincumo lesinesibindzi, hhayi kuyijika-jika.

rounds.literal: Umuntfu uhlezi nembuyana, ayidle nangelutsi linye lelicijile, kancane kakhulu kuze kuhlekise.
rounds.story: Lokusho kusetjentiswa uma umuntfu enta bugebengu, ubuqili noma umonakalo kancane kancane angafuni kubonakala.

rounds.literal: Babe ukhahle utjani lobuluhlata engadzeni, tihlangu tibhakabhaka ngelutfuli.
rounds.story: Lena yindlela lenhloniphekile yekubhekisela ekufeni ngaphandle kwekusho livi ngco.

rounds.literal: Tandla letimbili tigezana ngensipho, ngasinye sisita lesinye kufika emagwebu lamanyenti.
rounds.story: Bantfu bayisho uma bagcizelela kutsi umsebenti uyalula uma sisitana futsi sibambisana.

rounds.literal: Kukhuni lokumanti kufakwe emlilweni, kuphume intfutfu kuphela kube nelangabi alifuni kubamba.
rounds.story: Kusetjentiswa uma intfo yentiwa isengakalungeli, ngako ayihambi kahle noma ayiphumelelanga.

rounds.literal: Ingwenya ihleke emfuleni, ibambe kudla kahle emantini lapho yati khona konkhe.
rounds.story: Lena isetjentiswa uma kukhonjwa kutsi umuntfu uba nemandla endzaweni noma emsebentini lajwayele wona.

rounds.literal: Indlovu ihamba nemumboko wayo lomkhulu, kodvwa ayikhonondi futsi ayiwisi phansi.
rounds.story: Bantfu bayisho uma batsi umsebenti noma umtfwalo wakho akufanele ukubaleke ngoba uwakho.

rounds.literal: Umutsi ume kahle ngaphandle, kepha ngekhatsi kunetinhlwa letiwudlako tivele tibuthule.
rounds.story: Isetjentiswa uma umonakalo noma ingxabano icala kancane ngaphakathi bantfu bangakaboni.

rounds.literal: Umuntfu ugoba lutsanga lusemanzi kalula, kantsi lolomile luyachachatela.
rounds.story: Bantfu bayisebentisa uma bakhuluma ngekucecesha, kufundzisa nekululeka kusenesikhatsi.

rounds.literal: Emasimini kugijima emaguma, lelidzala lihamba embili kwangatsi lihola lamanye.
rounds.story: Lena ikhumbuta kutsi labadzala noma labanemava bavame kuhola ngoba bati lokunyenti.

kids.literal: Licala lihleli ebhasikidini tinsuku letinyenti, kodvwa aliboli njengekutja.
kids.story: Kushiwo uma umuntfu ente lokubi. Noma sekudlule sikhatsi, lelophutsa lingabuya limlandze.

kids.literal: Make ubambe mbeleko yakhe ngisho noma ake wakhala, akayijiki ayilahle.
kids.story: Bantfu bakusho uma bafuna kutsi uchubeke utame, noma intfo ike yahamba kabi ekucaleni.

kids.literal: Umfana ubeka indlebe yakhe etulu kwelitafula kwangatsi ifuna kulalela yodvwa.
kids.story: Kushiwo uma umuntfu kufanele alalelisise kahle loko lokushiwo ngulomunye.

kids.literal: Gogo ufaka liso lakhe elikhulu ebhokisini lebhisikidi kwangatsi liyagada lingaphumi.
kids.story: Bantfu bayisho uma utsi awugade intfo noma ubukisise kutsi konkhe kuhamba kahle.

kids.literal: Emehlo avuleka abemakhulu kwangatsi ngemafasitelo lavuliwe ekuseni.
kids.story: Lokusho kusetjentiswa uma umuntfu acala kubona kahle kutsi intfo injani sibili.

kids.literal: Umuntfu uhlezi nepuleti letinhlungu kwangatsi kudla, kepha uchubeka athule.
kids.story: Kushiwo uma umuntfu acondzela ebunzimeni kodvwa angayekeli.

kids.literal: Bantfwana bahamba babheke embili kepha tinyawo tibuyela emuva, bahleka bodvwa.
kids.story: Lena isho kuyekela intfukutselo nekutsetselela emva kwekoniwa.

kids.literal: Umlomo uboshwe ngelibhande lelincane, emagama afuna kuphuma kepha abuyele ngekhatsi.
kids.story: Kusetjentiswa uma kumele uthule, ungakhulumi noma ungaveti imfihlo.

kids.literal: Bangani lababili babambene tandla bacondze kuphakamisela umtfwalo lomkhulu etulu.
kids.story: Bantfu bakusho uma umuntfu asite lomunye ngemsebenti, ngemali noma ngemavi lamnandzi.

kids.literal: Bantfu labanyenti bahamba nemilomo levulekile, ligama linye ligcuma liphuma kuwo wonkhe.
kids.story: Kushiwo uma indzaba yemuntfu seyatiwa kakhulu futsi seyikhulunywa ngibo bonkhe.
